title: Surbiton Emergency Help Points
summary: Offline guide to 24-hour A&E, urgent care, local hazards, and emergency supplies in Surbiton.
content:
For any life-threatening emergency, always call 999 immediately (or 112).

1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospital:
Kingston Hospital, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB.
- Travel: From Surbiton railway station, it is approximately a 30-minute walk (1.4 miles) north via Claremont Road, Penrhyn Road, and Kingston Hill, or take bus 281 or 71 north towards Kingston and connect along Kingston Hill.
- Major Trauma Centre: St George's Hospital, Blackshaw Road, Tooting, SW17 0QT (approx. 6 miles east; take South Western Railway to Wimbledon, then bus 57 or 131 to Tooting).

2. Urgent Treatment Centre (UTC):
Kingston Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Galsworthy Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT2 7QB (co-located at the hospital main entrance; open 24 hours for urgent non-life-threatening conditions).

3. Local Area Hazards:
- Fluvial and surface flooding risks run along the River Thames to the west (Portsmouth Road promenade) and the Hogsmill River along the eastern Berrylands border.
- Low-lying underpasses near Berrylands railway station and Surbiton Hill road bridges may flood during intense storms.

4. Essential Supplies During Outages:
Pharmacies and major grocery stores along Victoria Road, Brighton Road, and Claremont Road provide over-the-counter medication, first-aid materials, and bottled water.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
